frames.heading: Zapp
frames.body: Whoa, friends! Your funk is unparalleled. Let's head on down to Jive Junction and gain recruits!

frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: Hey dudes, it's about time you came! This is Jive Junction, a place for people to come together and make music without the Grand Composer's knowledge.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Nice, don't let him kill your groove!

frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: We wanted to warn you about the Grand Composer's new plan.

frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: We've noticed space junk is starting to pile up in the sky of Funktopolis. If you look out into the sky, you can see a new planet forming.

frames.heading: Zapp
frames.body: The Grand Composer is making a new planet to amplify his silence across the whole Universe!!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: This can't possibly be! We must put a stop to this. Rockers of Jive Junction, stand with me and groove!!!
